skills.name: implement

skills.description: Answer how something works or why it was built that way, with file and line evidence and the history behind it, before anything changes. Use for an interlock investigation task, and to ground a bug fix, feature or refactor.

skills.description: Adversarially review a submitted interlock result before it is verified: findings with evidence, a lead judgment on each (act on, consider, noted, dismissed), dismissals kept, and the act-on findings handed to the verifier.

skills.description: Start here for any request to investigate, fix, build or restructure code in a repository that uses interlock. Picks the workflow (investigation, bug fix, feature, refactor), writes its acceptance criteria, and creates the interlock task.

skills.description: Hand an interlock task that awaits verification to the independent verifier agent, then let interlock decide: verified, sent back for rework, or still waiting. Use after a result is submitted, and never verify your own work.
